audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart sides (win[]/phases[].side) already match the mirror-realigned result, but the whys[] prose still argues the OLD chart: whys[0], whys[1], whys[5] and whys[6] tell the reader Tryndamere wins those stages while the row says Skill/Yorick.
audit.why: Two answers to 'who wins Level 1' on the same page. Sides are consistent across layers, so only prose needs to move.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[1], whys[5], whys[6] rewritten to state the side the row actually shows. No side/rating flips proposed — the chart is already mirror-aligned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage was described only as 'Unkillable 5s' with no cooldown, so the reader cannot time the window it opens.
audit.why: Riot kit gives R at 120/100/80s. That number is what makes 'wait it out' actionable.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries the 120/100/80s cooldown alongside the 5s duration.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text used the fabricated name 'Spinning Slashes'; dosFull[1] was titled 'Anti-heal his crit healing' but its body repeated the generic trade line; dontsFull[2] was titled 'Chase his spin' with an unrelated body.
audit.why: Riot's ability is Spinning Slash (E), 650 range, 12/11/10/9/8s. Bloodlust (Q) is the heal, 12s, and is the actual anti-heal target.
audit.corrected: Real name used; dosFull[1].d now states Bloodlust's 12s heal and the Executioner's Calling timing; dontsFull[2].d now states Spinning Slash's range and cooldown.

edits.before: Tryndamere's Fury crits and Bloodlust healing win the level 1 auto-war.
edits.after: Level 1 hinges on spacing: his Bloodlust heal versus your Q Last Rites.

edits.before: At 2 his sustained autos still beat your Q Last Rites trades.
edits.after: At 2 your E mark plus first ghouls out-trade his raw autos.

edits.before: First item swings back to Tryndamere as crit autos shred you in melee.
edits.after: Trinity Force plus Maiden lets you win the first-item side lane.

edits.before: Late, his R and Spinning Slash make him the superior, un-catchable splitter.
edits.after: Two items in, Maiden plus ghouls out-siege him — cage his Spinning Slash.

edits.before: Tryndamere spikes hard with Undying Rage (R): he can't die for 5 seconds, so any kill you set up he simply survives and Spinning Slashes away. Never blow your full combo expecting a kill through his ult; bait it, then re-engage.
edits.after: Tryndamere spikes with Undying Rage (R): 5 seconds unkillable on a 120/100/80s cooldown, so a kill you set up he survives and leaves on Spinning Slash (E). Never spend your full combo through his ult; bait it, then re-engage inside those 100 seconds.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Wait it out, then swarm. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Undying Rage is 5s unkillable on a 120/100/80s cooldown — bait it, then swarm.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Tryndamere so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Bloodlust is a 12s heal he cashes at low HP — buy Executioner's Calling on your first back and his comeback sustain loses to your ghoul chip.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Spinning Slash is 650 range on 12/11/10/9/8s — chasing it with no ghouls up leaves you alone in his half.

notes: Level chart left untouched: sides already agree across both layers and match the mirror's realignment, so only the stale whys[] prose was corrected. Whether Dark Procession's wall actually stops Spinning Slash's targeted dash is not in Riot's text — not asserted anywhere.
